You could be paying to attract customers while quietly losing the ones you already have.

Most of these losses never show up in your marketing reports.

1. The call nobody picked up
“I’ll call them back.” Nobody did.

2. The price you sent on Tuesday
They went quiet. You assumed they weren’t interested.

3. The message on your website
They messaged Friday night. You replied Monday.

4. The happy customer
Nobody asked for a review while the experience was still fresh.

5. The regular you haven’t seen since spring
Nobody followed up or gave them a reason to return.

Each one feels small.

Together, they’re a second business you’re giving away.

Before spending more to attract new customers, look at where you’re losing the ones who already showed interest.

Today, pick one number and ask your team for a rough count.
